entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I have a VeloBand Pulse, and I think I need to send it back. I'm a little confused about how to do it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
It's Sarah Gable. The order number is... VF78-B45-119P.

Thank you, Sarah. I've pulled up your account. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the situation? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works fine. I just... I think I've changed my mind. To be honest, it was a bit of an impulse buy, and I just don't use it like I thought I would. The website was a little overwhelming.
I understand. So it's not meeting your personal expectations at the moment.
Exactly. I saw something online about a VeloFit resale page or something... is that what I have to do? It all seems so complicated. Can't you just help me?
No need to worry about the marketplace, I can definitely help you directly. Let me just double-check our current return policy for you. Please hold one moment.

Thanks for waiting, Sarah. I've reviewed your order and our policy. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! I was so worried it would be a huge hassle. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. You should see the refund within 5-7 business days after we receive it.
That is such a relief. Thank you, Alex. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
